response: {"text":"This document presents a condensed version of a doctoral dissertation completed within a university’s physics department. The original research explored the quantum mechanical description of materials in which neighboring atomic spins align oppositely, a phenomenon known as antiferromagnetism. The work also compared several computational approaches to predict the behavior of such systems under varying conditions. Overall, the report summarizes the key concepts, methods, and conclusions drawn from the extensive graduate‑level investigation, offering a comprehensive overview of the quantum theory underlying antiferromagnetic materials."}
